message.reasoning:
NC Avenue is mortgaged, so accepting it means paying interest or unmortgaging later, roughly $150 either way. For green, p3 owns Pennsylvania so I can't complete the set without them, but taking it blocks p3's own green ambitions, though it also funds p4 to build on dark blue which hurts me. I'm weighing p3's position as leader with oranges against the fact they also hold light purple properties.

Looking at my own standing, I've got decent cash but scattered colors across yellow, green, light blue, and brown, so I really need a monopoly to break through. NC mainly serves to block p3 from green, but its value is moderate given the fee cost. I'm more drawn to pushing for yellow instead — if I could land Marvin Gardens plus Atlantic, I'd have a real monopoly with my cash reserves to back it. The risk is that paying p4 enough to interest them in a deal also funds their ability to build on dark blue. I'm leaning toward offering around $300 for Marvin Gardens to try to lock up yellow.
